entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. I need to return something and your website is a complete joke. Just get me a human being!
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. I understand you're having some trouble, and I can definitely help you with that. Could I start with your order number?
It's VF-8675309. I want to return this helmet I bought. It's been a nightmare from the start.

Okay, let me pull that up for you... I see the order for the Apex Pro helmet. I'm sorry to hear you've had a frustrating experience. To make sure I get this right for you, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

What kind of question is that? The issue is that the color is completely wrong! It looked bright red on the website and it's some kind of faded maroon. I haven't even touched it, the box is still unopened. I just want my money back. Now.
I can certainly understand that disappointment when the color isn't what you expected. Let me just check the policy and delivery date for you...

Don't you 'check the policy' with me! I know my rights! This is unacceptable. If I don't have a return label in my inbox in the next five minutes, I'm lighting you up on every social media platform and cycling forum I can find. Get me your manager, I'm done talking to you!

I assure you, a manager isn't necessary. I can process this for you right now. I've pulled up your order and I see it was delivered 35 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I'm approving the return immediately.
So you can do your job. Fine. And it's a full refund, right? No shipping fees, no restocking garbage?

That's correct, a full refund to your original payment method. The return shipping is on us. I've just sent the pre-paid label to your email. Also, I see you're a VIP Gold member with us. For the trouble with the website's color display and this whole experience, I've gone ahead and added a $50 credit to your account. We take rider safety and satisfaction very seriously, and we failed to meet that standard here.
Fifty dollars? Well... okay. That's something, I guess. It shouldn't have been this hard. Just make sure that email actually shows up.
It's already been sent. You should see it within the next minute or two. Once we receive the unopened box, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. We appreciate your business. Have a good day.
